sections.h2: An E10 engine on E20 gets about 4% more air than its fuel needs

chart.title: Ethanol needs less air per kilogram, so E20 runs leaner than E10
chart.sub: Kilograms of air needed to burn one kilogram of fuel.
chart.source: This blog's arithmetic from standard fuel properties.

sections.means: An engine that does not adjust its fuel for ethanol's oxygen runs leaner, which heats the plug tip and speeds electrode wear.
sections.todo: Carburettor owners should ask a workshop to re-set the mixture for E20, which addresses the cause rather than only swapping plugs.

sections.h2: Motorcycle plugs need replacing far sooner than car plugs

chart.title: Conventional motorcycle plugs are due every 3,000–5,000 km, cars 15,000–20,000 km
chart.source: Honda Activa owner's and service manuals; Denso spark plug catalogue.

sections.means: On a commuter scooter, E20 would add about ₹60 a year in plugs, a small sum next to the mileage loss.
sections.todo: Measure plug wear on E20 in carburetted two-wheelers before assuming the cost is small.

sections.h2: China supplied 84% of imported plugs, at about 10 US cents each

sections.means: The value in India's plug imports sits with premium-tip suppliers in Japan, Thailand and South Korea, while China supplies most of the pieces.
